name: mahjong-match-tool
description: 麻将消除小游戏网页工具（单文件离线版）

scripts.test:ae: node test/ae-export.mjs && node test/ae-mock.mjs samples/ae_export_sample.zip samples/ae_export_manual.zip && node test/ae-composite.mjs
scripts.test:logic: esbuild test/logic-test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.woff=dataurl --loader:.ttf=dataurl --log-level=warning --outfile=/tmp/mj-logic.mjs && node /tmp/mj-logic.mjs && esbuild test/repair-test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.woff=dataurl --loader:.ttf=dataurl --log-level=warning --outfile=/tmp/mj-repair.mjs && node /tmp/mj-repair.mjs
scripts.test:ae:mideast: AE_THEME=mideast AE_SUFFIX=_mideast AE_OUT=/tmp/aeexp_me node test/ae-export.mjs && node test/ae-mock.mjs samples/ae_export_sample_mideast.zip samples/ae_export_manual_mideast.zip && CHECK_OUT=screenshots/ae_export_check_mideast.jpg node test/ae-composite.mjs samples/ae_export_sample_mideast.zip /tmp/aeexp_me/snapsA
